test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-6) Official paper (Held On: 9 May 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: According to the Census of India 2011, how many "*million-plus cities*" were there in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**53**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• By the** 2011 census**, there were 53 million-plus cities in India, with **Delhi, Mumbai,** and **Kolkata** having populations over 10 million.
 
• There are** 53 urban **agglomerations in India with a population of 1 million or more by the 2011 census.
 
• According to the** 2001** census, there were** 35** cities in India that have more than 1 million population.
 
• **31.165 %** population can be categorized under Urban as per the 2011 Census.
 
• By census 2011,** Goa** is the most urbanized state with **62.17%** of the population living in urban areas.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• According to Census 2001, over** 70%** lived in rural areas.
 
• By the 2001 census,** 35** urban agglomerations in India with a population of 1 million or more.
